correctness.rationale: For each shore of size s, legal strong-majority play is exactly a k-bin occupancy process with every bin capped at floor(s/2). A nonfull dead state exists exactly when k floor(s/2)<s; otherwise at least one color remains legal until the shore is full. Applying this independently to both shores proves the claimed all-palette criterion and the exact parity formula. The bundled verifier independently enumerates reachable occupancy states for small s and checks the closed formula through m,n=100.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of a newly introduced game parameter on the canonical two-parameter complete-bipartite family. It proves more than the minimum palette size: for every palette size it identifies exactly when every legal play is forced to finish, revealing a sharp static-to-game collapse and a parity boundary.
